text: Diagnosis: This is a poorly differentiated carcinoma (in this case, conforming to the neuro-endocrine. type, G3), with infiltration of the terminal ileum and the serosa (p T 4) and with. extensive infiltration of the lymph and blood vessels (L 1, V 1), furthermore, with free. resection margins in the region of the mucosal membrane and a free ligature area and free. lymph nodes (p N 0). Tumor classification: ICDO-DA-M 8140/3. G3. p T 4, L 1, V 1, p NO, MX.
